name: word-language
description: The word language for .w files: highlighting, diagnostics, go-to-definition, hover, an outline, completion, formatting, references and rename.

word.compilerPath.description: Path to the word compiler. When it's empty, the server tries $WORD_BIN, then ./word (word.exe on Windows) in the workspace root, then `word` on PATH. Diagnostics and formatting come from the compiler, so without one there are neither.

word.languageServer.enable.description: Run the language server. With it off you still get syntax highlighting, which doesn't need the server.
